rtr.text: New Prahv is built once popular support grows and Isperia accepts leadership of the Azorius guild. In its halls Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and signing an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations once he sees the bribe amount.

The courtroom of New Prahv is also where Oana sprints late to defend a client, only to see Arbiter Johvann convict him of selling medicinal supplies without a license for announcing fresh vegetables for sale. Broken and blaming herself, she is offered a memory transfer from her dead grandfather by Tarem, whom she recognizes as Dimir and angrily refuses.

Decades later Oana is an esteemed arbiter, but Tarem, unaged, waits in her home and demands she acquit an accused in an Izzet League theft case. She realizes the memory of the offer was altered and that she had agreed to one favor to be named later, so she resigns, confesses and recuses herself from her cases.

clu.text: Dovin Baan orders New Prahv sealed and planeswalker activity reported, while the Conclave's trained falcons scout Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv and Orzhova for critical intelligence.
